observations: Three photos of used tires with a winter or all-season tread pattern.
Photo 2 shows the name 'MASTER-GRIP' embossed on the sidewall.
Tread depth appears deep in close-up shots 0 and 1.
Watermarks for 'D-KACHI ENTERPRISE' and 'JIJI' are visible on all photos.
Tire size markings are present on the sidewall in photo 2 but are too blurry to read.
No DOT date code is visible to determine the age of the rubber.
The tires have a high-gloss finish, likely from tire dressing/shine.
